<!--
  A page section: the landmark named by its heading, the heading (h1 or h2), an optional lead, the body
  (`children`) and optional media. `layout` stacks everything or puts the media beside the text; `boxed` puts
  the body in a card. Axes: layout, media side, tone, density, align.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SectionHeading, HeadLink, SectionMedia } from "./section-frame.types";
  import { variants } from "../utils";

  /** SectionFrame: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
  export const sectionFrameVariants = variants({
    base: "w-full",
    variants: {
      tone: {
        default: "",
        muted: "bg-muted",
        inverse: "bg-foreground text-background [&_.text-muted-foreground]:text-background/70",
      },
      density: {
        roomy: "py-16",
        default: "py-10",
        compact: "py-6",
        flush: "py-0",
      },
      align: {
        start: "",
        center: "text-center",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { tone: "default", density: "default", align: "start" },
  });

  export type SectionFrameProps = {
    id: string;
    title?: string;
    lead?: string;
    heading?: SectionHeading;
    action?: HeadLink;
    layout?: "stack" | "split";
    media?: SectionMedia;
    boxed?: boolean;
    tone?: "default" | "muted" | "inverse";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact" | "flush";
    align?: "start" | "center";
    measure?: "default" | "landing" | "fill" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    aside?: Snippet;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import SectionBox from "../components/section-box.svelte";
  import SectionColumn from "../components/section-column.svelte";
  import SectionHeader from "../components/section-header.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title = "",
    lead,
    heading,
    action,
    layout = "stack",
    media,
    boxed = false,
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    align = "start",
    measure = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    class: className,
    children,
    aside,
  }: SectionFrameProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const sectionTone = $derived(boxed ? "default" : tone);
  const center = $derived((align as string) === "center");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={cn(sectionFrameVariants({ tone: sectionTone, density: density, align: align }), className)}
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : (((title as string) !== "") ? titleId : undefined))}
  aria-label={(landmarkLabel ?? (((title as string) === "") ? id : undefined))}
  data-testid="section"
  data-tone={tone}
  data-density={density}
>
  <Container
    class={
      (measure as string) === "landing" ? cn("mx-auto w-full px-4", defaults.section.landing)
      : (measure as string) === "fill" ? "w-full"
      : "mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4"
    }
    data-slot="container"
  >
    <SectionBox boxed={boxed}>
      {#if ((layout as string) === "split")}
        <Grid cols="1-2" class={cn("gap-8", ((media?.align === "start") ? "items-start" : "items-center"))}>
          {#if (media?.show && (media?.side === "start"))}
            <Box class="w-full" data-slot="media">
              {@render aside?.()}
            </Box>
          {/if}
          <Stack gap="6" align="stretch">
            <SectionHeader titleId={titleId} title={title} heading={heading} action={action} lead={lead} center={center} />
            {@render children?.()}
          </Stack>
          {#if (media?.show && (media?.side !== "start"))}
            <Box class="w-full" data-slot="media">
              {@render aside?.()}
            </Box>
          {/if}
        </Grid>
      {:else}
        <SectionColumn measure={measure}>
          <SectionHeader titleId={titleId} title={title} heading={heading} action={action} lead={lead} center={center} />
          {@render children?.()}
          {#if media?.show}
            <Box class="w-full" data-slot="media">
              {@render aside?.()}
            </Box>
          {/if}
        </SectionColumn>
      {/if}
    </SectionBox>
  </Container>
</Block>
